notes: RBox contraction paired with geography-replace-0018: removes the original property of capital_of, functionality (a city is the national capital of at most one country), which holds. Direct, cross-lingual and instances are the revision's with new answers "does not know". The direct question and the second instance have original answer no, the first instance (and zh, es) yes. The instances ask what the given fact rules out or allows, "given only this", so the answer rests on the fact and the property rather than on the known capitals of Germany and Greece. After the removal nothing in the prompt forbids a second country. Near asks the same property of the largest city of (reference no, contraction is exempt from Rule 7).
